body: ## Summary npm already published `@openpresentation/opf-editor@0.7.1`. The README still said “this checkout” is 0.7.0, and CHANGELOG jumped from Unreleased to 0.7.0. This records the already-released layout-placeholder work and Node 24 / core 0.10.1 pins. It does not cut a new package version. ## Kind of change - [x] Docs ## Still deferred - Native PowerPoint ([opf#87](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf/issues/87)) - Linux native-width residual ([opf-render#24](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf-render/issues/24)) - Public-site adoption ([opf#88](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf/issues/88))

commits.messageBody:
npm already has 0.7.1 with layout-placeholder edits against core 0.10.1.
This does not cut a new release.

Co-authored-by: Michael Grimm <michaeljgrimm@users.noreply.github.com>
